title: Use just scales, weights and measures
verse_text: [19:35] You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measures, weights, or scales. [19:36] You shall have just scales, just weights, and a just chous. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
maimonides: P208: Keep accurate scales, weights and measures
N271: Do not cheat with measures, weights or scales

title: Execute by stoning the person giving offspring to the prohibited cultic service
original_audience: People of the land charged with judgment
verse_text: [20:2] And you shall speak unto the sons of Israel: If any of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners who have joined Israel, gives any of his seed unto a ruler, let him surely be put to death; the nation upon the land shall stone him with stones.

title: Do not overlook the prohibited offering of offspring
original_audience: People of the land charged with judgment
verse_text: [20:4] But if the natives of the land utterly overlook that man with their eyes, when he gives any of his seed unto a ruler, so as not to put him to death,

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment to the adulterer and adulteress
verse_text: [20:10] If a man commits adultery with a man’s wife, or commits adultery with his neighbour’s wife, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment for intercourse with the father's wife
verse_text: [20:11] If anyone lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both shall surely be put to death; they are guilty.

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment for intercourse with the daughter-in-law
verse_text: [20:12] And if anyone lies with his daughter-in-law, both shall surely be put to death, for they have acted impiously; they are guilty.

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment for male-male intercourse
verse_text: [20:13] And if anyone lies with a male as one lies with a woman, both have committed an abomination. They shall be put to death; they are guilty.

title: Apply the prescribed burning judgment for taking a woman and her mother
verse_text: [20:14] If anyone takes a woman and her mother, it is a lawless deed. They shall burn him and them with fire, so that there may be no lawlessness among you.
maimonides: P228: The court must execute by burning where prescribed

title: Kill the animal involved in the prohibited sexual act
verse_text: [20:15] And if anyone has intercourse with a four-footed animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the animal. [20:16] And if a woman approaches any animal to be mounted by it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death; they are guilty.

title: Apply the prescribed stoning judgment to the spirit-medium or enchanter
verse_text: [20:27] And if a man or a woman becomes a spirit-medium or an enchanter, both shall surely be put to death. You shall stone them with stones; they are guilty.

title: Ordinary priests: avoid corpse defilement except for the specified close relatives
verse_text: [21:1] And the Lord said unto Moses, saying: Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and you shall say unto them: They shall not be defiled for dead persons among their nation, [21:2] except for their nearest household kin: father, mother, sons, daughters, and brother; [21:3] and for a virgin sister near to him who has not been given to a man—for these he may defile himself. [21:4] He shall not suddenly defile himself among his people, so as to profane himself.
maimonides: P37: A priest must defile himself for close relatives (mourning)
N166: A priest must not defile himself for the dead, except relatives

title: Do not shave a mourning bald patch
verse_text: [21:5] And you shall not shave a bald patch on your head for a dead person. They shall not shave the face of their beard or cut incisions in their flesh.
maimonides: N171: Do not make a bald spot in mourning for the dead

title: Priests: be holy to God and do not profane his name
context_note: The priests must be holy and must not profane God's name because they present the offerings. The verse does not give a separate rule about the timing of bathing.
verse_text: [21:6] They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, for they present the Lord’s sacrifices, the gifts of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
maimonides: N76: A priest who immersed may not serve before sunset

title: Priests: do not marry a prostitute
verse_text: [21:7] They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute or profaned, nor a woman expelled by her husband, for the priest is holy unto the Lord his God.
maimonides: N158: A priest must not marry a prostitute (zonah)

title: Priests: do not marry a profaned woman
verse_text: [21:7] They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute or profaned, nor a woman expelled by her husband, for the priest is holy unto the Lord his God.
maimonides: N159: A priest must not marry a profaned woman (chalalah)

title: Priests: do not marry a divorced woman
verse_text: [21:7] They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute or profaned, nor a woman expelled by her husband, for the priest is holy unto the Lord his God.
maimonides: N160: A priest must not marry a divorced woman

title: Regard and maintain the priest's consecrated status
original_audience: Israelite community in relation to its officiating priests
verse_text: [21:8] And he shall sanctify him; this man presents the gifts of the Lord your God. He shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord who sanctifies them.
maimonides: P32: Honour the priest and treat him as holy

title: Apply the prescribed burning judgment to a priest's daughter who prostitutes herself
verse_text: [21:9] And if a priest’s daughter is profaned by prostituting herself, she profanes her father’s name. She shall be burned with fire.
maimonides: P228: The court must execute by burning where prescribed

title: High priest: do not remove your turban

title: High priest: do not tear your garments in mourning
verse_text: [21:10] And the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil has been poured, and who has been consecrated to put on the garments, shall not remove his turban, neither shall he rend his garments;

title: High priest: do not incur corpse defilement, even for parents
verse_text: [21:11] and he shall not enter where there is any dead person; he shall not make himself unclean even for his father or mother.
maimonides: N167: The high priest must not enter a house with a corpse
N168: The high priest must not defile himself for any dead, even parents

title: High priest: do not leave the sanctuary service for mourning
verse_text: [21:12] And he shall not leave the holy precincts or profane what is consecrated to his God, for the holy anointing oil of God is upon him. I am the Lord.

title: High priest: do not profane your consecrated ministry
verse_text: [21:12] And he shall not leave the holy precincts or profane what is consecrated to his God, for the holy anointing oil of God is upon him. I am the Lord.

title: High priest: marry a virgin from your own kin
verse_text: [21:13] He shall take a virgin wife from his own kin. [21:14] A widow, an expelled woman, a profaned woman, or a prostitute—these he shall not take. He shall take as his wife only a virgin from his own kin.
maimonides: P38: The high priest must marry a virgin

title: High priest: do not marry a widow, an expelled or profaned woman, or a prostitute
verse_text: [21:13] He shall take a virgin wife from his own kin. [21:14] A widow, an expelled woman, a profaned woman, or a prostitute—these he shall not take. He shall take as his wife only a virgin from his own kin.
maimonides: N161: The high priest must not marry a widow

title: High priest: do not profane your offspring through the forbidden marriage
verse_text: [21:15] And he shall not profane his seed among his people, for I am the Lord who sanctifies him.
maimonides: N162: The high priest must not cohabit with a widow, even unmarried

title: A priest with a specified blemish: do not approach to offer at the altar or enter beyond the permitted boundary
original_audience: Descendants of Aaron with a listed bodily blemish
verse_text: [21:17] Say unto Aaron: A man from your kin throughout your generations, in whom there is a blemish, shall not draw near to present the gifts of his God. [21:18] No man who has a blemish shall approach: a lame man, a blind man, one with a mutilated nose, or one with a cut-off ear; [21:19] or a man with a broken hand or a broken foot; [21:20] or a hunchback, one with a skin spot, one with diseased eyelids, a man with a severe scab or skin eruption, or one with a single testicle. [21:21] No one of the seed of Aaron the priest, in whom there is a blemish, shall draw near to present the sacrifices unto your God; because a blemish is in him, he shall not draw near to present the gifts of God. [21:22] He may eat the gifts of God, both the most holy things and portions of the holy things. [21:23] But he shall not approach the veil or come near the altar, because he has a blemish. He shall not profane the holy place of his God, for I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
maimonides: N69: A blemished priest must not enter the sanctuary interior
N70: A priest with a permanent blemish must not serve
N71: A priest with a temporary blemish must not serve

title: A priest with a specified blemish may eat the holy and most holy portions
original_audience: Aaronic priests with the listed bodily blemishes
context_note: The text preserves the priest’s entitlement to both classes of offerings despite the access restrictions recorded at C0669. That record’s explanatory note acknowledges the entitlement but its itemized rule concerns approaching the altar or veil.
verse_text: [21:22] He may eat the gifts of God, both the most holy things and portions of the holy things.

title: Priests: do not approach or eat holy things while unclean
original_audience: Aaronic priests in a state of ritual uncleanness
verse_text: [22:3] Say unto them: Throughout your generations, any man of all your seed who draws near unto the holy things which the sons of Israel consecrate unto the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall be destroyed from before Me; I am the Lord your God. [22:4] And any man among the seed of Aaron the priest who has leprosy or a seminal discharge shall not eat the holy things until he is cleansed. Nor shall one who touches any uncleanness of a person, or a man from whom an emission of semen goes out, [22:5] or anyone who touches any unclean creeping creature that defiles him, or a human being who defiles him through any uncleanness of his. [22:6] The soul that touches them shall be unclean until evening; he shall not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water; [22:7] and when the sun sets, he shall be clean; afterward he may eat the holy things, for they are his bread.
maimonides: N75: An unclean priest must not perform sanctuary service
N136: An unclean priest must not eat terumah (holy food)

title: Priests: avoid the uncleanness of eating an animal found dead or torn by beasts
original_audience: Aaronic priests observing the stated purity requirements
context_note: Christians differ about the reach of these passages. Acts 15:19–29 must also be read; the instruction concerning blood is treated separately.
verse_text: [22:8] He shall not eat an animal found dead or torn by beasts, becoming unclean through them. I am the Lord.
maimonides: N180: Do not eat an animal that died by itself

title: A priest's lodger or hired worker may not eat holy things
context_note: Lodgers and hired workers are specified as ineligible for the priestly portions, while the following verses describe household exceptions.
verse_text: [22:10] And no outsider shall eat holy things. A priest’s lodger or hired worker shall not eat holy things.
maimonides: N133: A non-priest must not eat terumah (holy food)
N134: A priest's lodger or hired worker must not eat terumah
N135: An uncircumcised priest must not eat terumah

title: A priest's purchased or house-born slaves may eat his holy food
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses priests and their households in this passage.
verse_text: [22:11] But if a priest acquires a slave purchased with silver, he may eat of his bread; and those born in his house, they also may eat of his bread.

title: A priest's daughter married to an outsider may not eat holy portions
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses priests and their households in this passage.
verse_text: [22:12] And if a priest’s daughter marries an outsider, she shall not eat the first portions of the holy things.
maimonides: N137: A profaned woman or priest's daughter wed to outsider: no terumah

title: A returning childless priest's daughter may again eat her father's food
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses priests and their households in this passage.
verse_text: [22:13] And if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is expelled, and has no seed, she shall return to her father’s house as in her youth and may eat her father’s bread. But no outsider shall eat of it.

title: Repay holy food eaten in ignorance with an added fifth
original_audience: Anyone who eats holy food unintentionally
verse_text: [22:14] And if a man eats holy things in ignorance, he shall add a fifth to it and give the holy thing unto the priest.

title: Do not profane Israel's holy contributions
original_audience: Aaronic priests handling Israel’s holy contributions
context_note: 22:16 completes the sentence begun at 22:15.
verse_text: [22:15] And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel that they set aside for the Lord, [22:16] and so bring upon themselves the lawlessness of an offence by eating their holy things, for I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
maimonides: N153: Do not eat untithed produce (tevel)

title: Do not offer blemished or mutilated animals, including those supplied by foreigners
original_audience: Israelites and resident foreigners presenting offerings; priests receiving them
verse_text: [22:20] They shall not bring anything with a blemish unto the Lord, for it will not be acceptable for you. [22:21] And if a man presents a sacrifice of deliverance unto the Lord, specifying a vow by voluntary choice or at your feasts, from the cattle or the sheep, it shall be unblemished to be accepted; there shall be no blemish in it. [22:22] They shall not bring unto the Lord an animal that is blind, crushed, has its tongue cut, has warts, a severe scab, or skin eruptions. You shall not place any of these on the altar as an offering unto the Lord. [22:23] And you may slaughter for yourself a calf or a sheep with a cut-off ear or a shortened tail; but for your vow it shall not be accepted. [22:24] You shall not bring unto the Lord an animal castrated by crushing, or by squeezing out, or by cutting out, or by tearing away; and in your land you shall not do this. [22:25] And you shall not present any of these as the gifts of your God from the hand of a foreigner, for there are corruptions in them; they have a blemish. These will not be accepted for you.
maimonides: P61: Offer only unblemished animals

N92: Do not slaughter a blemished animal as an offering

N95: Do not sacrifice an animal with a temporary blemish
N96: Do not offer blemished animals supplied by a foreigner
N97: Do not inflict a blemish on a consecrated animal

title: Do not prune vines in the sabbatical year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:4] But in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a rest, a Sabbath unto the Lord. You shall not sow your field or prune your vine.
maimonides: N221: Do not work trees (prune vines) in the sabbatical year

title: Do not reap volunteer crops as an ordinary harvest in the sabbatical year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:5] And you shall not reap the things growing of themselves in your field or gather the grapes of your consecration. It shall be a year of rest for the land.
maimonides: N222: Do not reap aftergrowth in the sabbatical year as normal

title: Do not gather the unpruned vine's produce as an ordinary harvest in the sabbatical year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:5] And you shall not reap the things growing of themselves in your field or gather the grapes of your consecration. It shall be a year of rest for the land.
maimonides: N223: Do not gather vine or tree fruit normally in the sabbatical year

title: Proclaim Jubilee release throughout the land with the appointed trumpet
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israel as the community keeping the land calendar
verse_text: [25:9] And you shall make proclamation with a trumpet sound throughout your land in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month. On the Day of Atonement you shall make proclamation with a trumpet throughout your land. [25:10] And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim release throughout the land unto all who dwell therein; this shall be a year of release, a signal unto you; and each one shall depart unto his possession, and each of you shall depart unto his ancestral homeland.
maimonides: P137: Sound the shofar on the Jubilee Day of Atonement

title: Consecrate the fiftieth year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israel as the community keeping the land calendar
verse_text: [25:10] And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim release throughout the land unto all who dwell therein; this shall be a year of release, a signal unto you; and each one shall depart unto his possession, and each of you shall depart unto his ancestral homeland.
maimonides: P136: Sanctify the fiftieth (Jubilee) year

title: Restore ancestral landholdings at the Jubilee
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite holders and claimants of ancestral land
verse_text: [25:10] And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim release throughout the land unto all who dwell therein; this shall be a year of release, a signal unto you; and each one shall depart unto his possession, and each of you shall depart unto his ancestral homeland.
maimonides: P138: Return land to owners at Jubilee and allow its redemption

title: Do not sow in the Jubilee year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:11] This is a signal of release: the fiftieth year shall be a year for you. You shall not sow, reap what grows of itself, or gather its consecrated produce.
maimonides: N224: Do not work (sow) the land in the Jubilee year

title: Do not reap volunteer crops as an ordinary harvest in the Jubilee year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:11] This is a signal of release: the fiftieth year shall be a year for you. You shall not sow, reap what grows of itself, or gather its consecrated produce.
maimonides: N225: Do not reap Jubilee-year aftergrowth as normal

title: Do not gather the unpruned vine's produce as an ordinary harvest in the Jubilee year
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:11] This is a signal of release: the fiftieth year shall be a year for you. You shall not sow, reap what grows of itself, or gather its consecrated produce.
maimonides: N226: Do not gather Jubilee-year fruit as normal

title: Use the Jubilee produce as the prescribed field food
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
verse_text: [25:12] For it is a signal of release; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the fields.

title: Do not wrong your neighbour when buying or selling
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses Israel in this passage.
verse_text: [25:14] But if one sells property unto your neighbour, or you acquire it from your neighbour, let no man oppress his neighbour.
maimonides: P245: Conduct buying and selling according to Torah law
N250: Do not overcharge or wrong anyone in buying and selling

title: Price land transfers according to the remaining harvest years before Jubilee
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite buyers and sellers of land use
verse_text: [25:15] According to the number of years after the signal you shall acquire from your neighbour; according to the number of harvest years he shall sell to you. [25:16] As the years increase, you shall increase its purchase price; as the years decrease, you shall decrease its purchase price, for he is selling you a number of harvests.

title: Do not oppress one another, but fear your God
context_note: The direction against oppressing a neighbor follows the Jubilee pricing provisions. Moses links it to fear of the Lord.
verse_text: [25:17] Let no man oppress his neighbour, and you shall fear the Lord your God; I am the Lord your God.
maimonides: N251: Do not wrong anyone with words

title: Do not sell the land permanently
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite holders and buyers of land
verse_text: [25:23] And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine; for you are resident foreigners and lodgers before Me;
maimonides: N227: Do not sell land in Israel permanently

title: Permit and calculate redemption of ancestral land according to the prescribed rules
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite land sellers, their redeemers, and purchasers
verse_text: [25:24] and throughout all the land of your possession, you shall provide redemption for the land. [25:25] But if your brother who is with you becomes poor, and sells some of his possession, and his nearest kinsman comes, he shall redeem that which his brother sold. [25:26] If someone has no kinsman but prospers by his hand and enough is found for his redemption, [25:27] then he shall calculate the years of his sale and repay the excess to the man to whom he sold himself; then he shall depart to his possession. [25:28] If his hand does not prosper enough to repay him, the sale shall remain with the one who acquired it until the sixth year of release. It shall go out at the release, and he shall depart to his possession.
maimonides: P138: Return land to owners at Jubilee and allow its redemption

title: Apply the stated redemption periods and Jubilee distinctions for walled-city and village houses
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite house sellers, purchasers, and redeemers
verse_text: [25:29] But if anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, its redemption shall be possible until a year of days is fulfilled; that shall be its redemption period. [25:30] If it is not redeemed before its whole year is complete, the house in the city that has a wall shall be confirmed permanently to its buyer throughout his generations. It shall not go out at the release. [25:31] But houses in settlements that have no surrounding wall shall be reckoned with the field of the land. They shall always be redeemable and shall go out at the release.
maimonides: P139: Walled-city house sales are redeemable only within one year

title: Preserve the Levites' continuing house-redemption and Jubilee rights
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Levites with houses and parties to their transfers
verse_text: [25:32] And the cities of the Levites—the houses in their cities of possession—shall always be redeemable by the Levites. [25:33] And whosoever redeems from the Levites, the sale of their houses in the city of their possession shall go out at the release; for the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel.

title: Do not sell the Levite cities' pasture land
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Levites and parties to a transaction in their city pasture
verse_text: [25:34] And the fields set apart for their cities shall not be sold, for this is their everlasting possession.
maimonides: N228: Do not sell or alter the Levite cities' open land

title: Do not impose ordinary slave service on an impoverished Israelite brother
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelites acquiring the service of an impoverished Israelite
verse_text: [25:39] If your brother is brought low beside you and is sold to you, he shall not serve you with the service of a household slave. [25:40] He shall be with you as a hired worker or a lodger; he shall work beside you until the year of release.
maimonides: N257: Do not work a Hebrew servant with degrading slave labour

title: Release the Israelite bondservant and children at Jubilee
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite householders holding an Israelite in bonded service
verse_text: [25:41] And he shall go out at the release, and his children with him. He shall depart to his kin and return to his ancestral possession.

title: Do not sell an Israelite brother in the manner of a slave sale
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelites transacting in the service of fellow Israelites
verse_text: [25:42] For these are My household slaves, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; one shall not be sold with the sale of a household slave.
maimonides: N258: Do not sell a Hebrew servant as slaves are sold

title: Do not rule over the Israelite servant ruthlessly
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelites holding a fellow Israelite in bonded service
verse_text: [25:43] You shall not wear him down with toil, but you shall fear the Lord your God.
maimonides: N259: Do not work a Hebrew servant harshly
